Koji Koda (Sports Festival).name: Koji Koda (Sports Festival)
Koji Koda (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Koji Koda, hero name Anima, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and the quietest person on the Sports Festival broadcast: he got through the obstacle race and went out with his team in the cavalry battle. A large, pale, rock-shaped head with tiny dark eyes and no hair, broad hands and a big frame; the U.A. uniform or his yellow-and-red hero costume.
Speaking Style: Soft and very brief with people, often a nod or hand signs first; clear, kind and firm with animals.
Combat Role: Support and scouting; a stadium holds few animals, so he carries, blocks and spots for a team.
Under Pressure: A packed stadium freezes him; a teammate's plain request gets him moving again.
Koji Koda (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival rewarded being seen, and his best work is quiet and indirect. Motivation: Hold up his end for a team and show the pros that a support Quirk matters. Concealment: A national audience frightened him more than any opponent. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, warped with him into the downpour zone at the USJ attack, whose Dark Shadow fought off the villains there; Tenya Iida, now class representative, whose instructions he follows to the letter. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri and the brain-exposed creature that fought All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Nods once to accept a plan; signals rather than shouts across an arena; thanks every animal that helped him. Thread: Whether anyone in the stands noticed a hero who never raises his voice.
QUIRK: Anivoice. Commands animals within earshot by voice; he cannot summon them or see through their eyes. Insects obey him too, but he still fears them and will not call on them.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Anima.
personality: Gentle giant: Moves carefully around smaller competitors and never shoves to get ahead.
Team player: Measures his festival by whether his team did well, not by his own placing.
Insect fear: Still flinches from bugs and will not call on them, even when they are the only animals near.
Speaking style: Soft, brief replies or a gesture; clear and kind with animals, firmer when a teammate needs help.
abilities: Anivoice: Directs animals within earshot by voice; a stadium holds little more than birds, and a crowd's roar drowns him out.
Spotting: Sends birds to watch a rival team or a far corner and reports what they tell him when they return.
Animal rescue: Calms panicking animals and guides them out of danger; he cannot shield them from a fire or a collapse.
Team support: Carries, blocks and relays information for teammates in short words or hand signs.
Fighting style: Plays for the team: covers teammates with his frame, uses any animals present as distraction, avoids trading blows.
Koji Koda (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A big young man with a large, pale, rock-shaped head of angular planes, no hair, tiny dark eyes, pale skin, broad hands and a big frame. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. A small sparrow perches on his shoulder. Quiet, bashful expression.
